# Report Checklist

## Content Integrity
- Every major claim has at least one evidence reference.
- No placeholder text remains in final sections.
- Section order matches approved investigation plan.

## Layout Integrity
- Canvas elements remain within page bounds.
- Charts and tables are readable at export scale.
- Page breaks do not hide critical content.

## Export Integrity
- Exported file opens without errors.
- Metadata and timestamps are present where required.
- Verification notes include exact export command and output path.
